n: WBS rules: the built-in WBS rows are editable too – pick another bucket or G&A group for Salaries · Wages · Bonus on that WBS; ↺ brings back the built-in
Your WBS rules: type the GL name the rule applies to (empty = every line on the WBS)
Mapping rules as lists: the GL list shows every GL with its bucket, G&A group and indirect code – change any of them in its box
Document types and WBS rules as tables you can change too; a bucket you change is kept as your rule and moves its lines at the next build (↻ Rebuild with your rules)
Indirect: each head in its colour with its cost elements, GLs and cost underneath · Special rules lists the few exceptions
Export to Excel starts with the GL list sheet
Page tabs: the amount sits beside the tab name, no more text running over it
Adjustment lines: the CJI3 + added − taken out = To date line is spaced and wraps on a narrow screen
Summary is calmer: one Needs attention line on top, 4 number cards with full text, the cost per month wide with the cut month in amber
Cost per month: the 6-month average written on its line; click a bucket (legend or table) to see it alone, click a month to open it in Expenses · Per month
Top 5 cost drivers with full names – All drivers › for the full list; Revenue and client deductions below them
Expenses opens on Per month – the Summary tab is gone (the Summary report shows the month at a glance)
Per month puts the months first: Bucket · Item · Description, then each month, the cut month highlighted, To date – PKG, MNL, cost element, source and the rest come after
Expenses: one title in the page header (Expenses · Summary, to the cut), one toolbar row, one ⇩ Export to Excel in the command bar
Period and Source are pick lists; the help line is behind ⓘ; fold / open all are ⊟ ⊞ at the start of the toolbar
New menu: MONTH CLOSE (1 Update · 2 Code · 3 Decide · 4 Forecast, each with a badge) · REPORTS · SETTINGS – always with words; ☰ folds it to a thin rail for more table width
On top of each page: one command bar (Update SAP files · Undo · Export · ‹ back · Next ›) and a header with the key figures of the step
The pages of a step are tabs above the table (Code: Material 538 · Subcontractor 97 …), the groups in a Group pick list; a step opens on its first open task
Your company logo in the header and on a new start page built around the 4 steps
Budget: the Direct plan is read by its item totals (Takeoff, EV Q.) – no building columns needed; an item's PKG comes from the Cost Analysis
Progress: one done quantity per BOQ item (take-off, done to date, left, % done) – a split by building typed before counts as its sum

Another cost report layout: when a column is not found, Match the columns opens with the tool's guesses – pick the red ones; BAC and EV are checked against the file; kept for next time · Check the columns… on the Budget page
Budget: reads a cost report in a second layout too – per building "B04 Takeoff" / "B04 EV Q." and one Cost Analysis header row ("CSI Code (PKG)", items at level 4, resources at level 5)
Division rows that carry an item code are read as headings and give the PKG its name
Built-in indirect list: 30605800 Location service → SE-12 Surveying Equipment · 32000039 DC-Furn. & Fixture → SP-09 · 32000057 ACs & Computers and 32000056 IT Equip&Telec. Dev. → SP-15
Items with an empty cost element get it from the list; a code you typed stays
Excel export › Lines: a Name (CJI3) column next to Description
The Lines sheet still reads back with Import codes – a PKG, MNL or cost element typed on a line comes back for that line
New report: Reports › Client › Client invoices – every client invoice in CJI3 (billing documents RV) and the opening balance
Tab 1 · Invoice register: by month, one row per invoice with gross, each client deduction GL and net, cumulative · click an invoice for its lines by WBS
Tab 2 · WBS × month: following the WBS structure, net invoiced per month, cost to date on that WBS and below, margin and % · WBS never invoiced together in one row · ⇩ Excel
